resources.string: Your phone on the big screen
CastApp sends your screen, videos, music and photos to your TV over your Wi-Fi. No account, no ads.
Pick a TV, then mirror or cast
TVs on your Wi-Fi appear on the main screen. Tap \"Cast\" to mirror your screen, or tap the TV itself for more: a single app, files, or the sound only.
Files, web, TV channels and network
Cast files from your phone or a cloud app, videos from websites, TV channels with a programme guide, and media from Plex, Jellyfin, a NAS or a PC.

The remote steers your TV over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or infrared. CastApp works with Chromecast, Android TV, Fire TV, DLNA and AirPlay TVs. Install CastApp TV on an Android TV or Fire TV for the lowest delay and more features.
A short introduction to what CastApp can do

Light, dark or like the system
Picture, sound and connection settings go back to their defaults. Your theme, TVs, channels and accounts are kept.
CastApp removes this TV from your saved TVs. It shows up again when it is found on your Wi-Fi.

CastApp forgets this account on this phone. You can sign in again at any time.
The channel list is removed from CastApp. You can add it again at any time; your recordings stay.
